text: anya: Heads-up — docs site CI failing after the migration. Netlify build is aborting with broken-anchor errors; the HTML validator chokes and the deploy fails. Excerpt from the build log below: anya: ``` Error: Could not resolve anchor 'sdk-install' referenced from docs/quickstart.md:42 Warning: broken anchor: '#quickstart-auth' referenced in docs/auth.md Build failed: HTML validation error ``` sam: Do we have a mix of MkDocs and Docusaurus anchor syntax? I remember MkDocs used {#some_id} and Docusaurus relies on generated slugs (github-slugger) so underscores vs hyphens can mismatch. kevin: Yep — that and some headings include inline code/emoji which slugifies differently. Quick fixes: add explicit heading ids (MDX syntax) like: kevin: ``` ## SDK install {#sdk-install} ``` kevin: or add an HTML anchor above the heading: `` . Longer term we should normalize link generation during migration. maria: I'm going to open a tiny PR to add explicit ids for the problem pages (quickstart, sdk, auth) and update sidebar links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 — assigning @kevin for review. I will run a local `yarn docusaurus build` to verify. ci-bot: Netlify deploy 5234 failed: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/5234 — logs attached. kevin: Also double-check any internal relative anchors in docs/_sidebar.js and links like `[Install](#sdk_install)` — prefer full path `(/docs/quickstart#sdk-install)` or normalized anchors. anya: Note — some migrated MkDocs pages kept `{#sdk_install}` (underscore). We should run a small regex to convert anchors and heading ids to hyphenated form: search `\{#([a-z0-9_\-]+)\}` and replace underscores with hyphens for Docusaurus compatibility. I'll draft the script and push it to the migration tooling. maria: Also found a minor formatting issue: fenced codeblocks with trailing language tokens like "```bash " (extra space) caused a parser warning in MDX. Fixed those in the same PR. sam: Thanks — after PR merges I'll re-run CI. @ci-bot can you queue a redeploy once merged? :pray: ci-bot: Redeploy queued — job 5241 queued by CI. maria: PR merged and deploy 5241 passed — site is live. :tada: anya: Closing this thread — thanks for the quick turnaround. If anyone sees a stray broken anchor ping here and I will add it to the sweep-up script.
